name: plugin.task_planner
description: Hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) goal decomposition and milestone dependency tracker

entrypoints.name: plan_decompose_goal
entrypoints.description: Create a new DAG execution plan for a goal with task dependencies

parameters.name: subtasks
parameters.description: List of subtasks ({id, title, description, depends_on})

entrypoints.name: plan_get_next_milestone
entrypoints.description: Get the next unblocked task(s) whose dependencies are completed

entrypoints.name: plan_update_status
entrypoints.description: Update task status (pending, in_progress, completed, failed) and attach result

entrypoints.name: plan_export_dag
entrypoints.description: Export the DAG plan in structured JSON and Mermaid graph format
